### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context">I would like to share an update on the malaria program in Afghanistan. The program revised the National Treatment Guidelines (NTG) in 2025 and introduced a short course of primaquine for the radical treatment of P. vivax cases. Additionally, there are plans to pilot the use of tafenoquine in one of the malaria high-burden provinces.<br><br>The program has procured G6PD testing analyzers and test kits with financial support from the government budget to ensure proper assessment of malaria patients’ G6PD status. All of these actions have been taken with support from OAT in the country.</div>

## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days or PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days or TQ (pilot) | Not specified |
| **G6PD Intermediate** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 7 days or PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Close medical supervision |
| **G6PD Deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Strict medical supervision |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Close medical supervision |
